name: Fleurety
source:
An ancient Majin who served the Demon Sovereign Rikshima, she is the master of the "Disaster" phenomenon which regularly invades Grasesta at the start of the tale. She has command over the powers of ice and hail, all who enter her "Disaster" either freeze to death or are killed by the monsters which inhabit within. Capricious and sadistic, she possesses immense power but is bored easily and can abandon the task at hand at will.

[Spoiler] She first encounters Judar in the valley next to the slave pit. As he is one of the rare few to survive an encounter with her, she is pleased to meet him a second time when she attempts to destroy a prison which she believes houses the body of her fallen sire. On a whim, she implants a part of Rikshima's flesh into Judar, promising that if he masters the implant he will become stronger than he already is, in addition to becoming something other than human.

Fleurety is initially working together with the organization behind the Unidentified Living Organisms (不命体) in exchange for information on the whereabouts of her liege's body. She then joins Judar's party when they reach an agreement whereby Lilica and Judar will attempt to find the truth behind Rikshima's fate while she tags along to oversee their progress. 

Fleurety is absolutely devoted to her former liege and has devoted everything to resurrecting Rikshima. She has no camaraderie with other demon kind and will happily kill anything, human or demon, which stands in her way. She treats Judar as a toy and gains satisfaction from baiting him when she joins the party.

At the end of the tale, Fleurety continues her pact with Judar and promises not to attack Grasesta for as long as he lives. Judar for his part does not trust her because of her capriciousness and promises to kill her should she change her mind and resume her attacks on the city. [/Spoiler]
